package_purpose: Delegated personal visual review after original1184 atomic publication and root-owned QI1440.

review_method.published_png_hash_role: producer_declared_only from render-publish-receipt.json; no source-agent digest computed

visual_decision.initial_state: At frame 0 blue fluid occupies the lower channel/bed region; the orange vertical moving boundary is coherent at the left end and grey fixed sloped bed/walls are visible without an obvious initial clip or gap artifact.
visual_decision.mechanism: The inspected sequence shows boundary-driven runup/flow evolution along the fixed sloped bed. This case has 4,210 moving particles and zero floating particles, so no floating-body mechanism is claimed.
visual_decision.mid_event: Mid-time contacts show a contiguous blue fluid body and changing front/profile along the slope; the orange moving boundary remains coherent. No obvious catastrophic spray cloud or disconnected numerical plume is visible.
visual_decision.late_state: Late contacts and frame 800 show the fluid visibly bounded within the channel/bed view and the render reaches the reported final frame/time; the late profile remains coherent at the available camera scale.
visual_decision.penetration_screen: No obvious severe blue-fluid penetration into the grey fixed bed/walls, or orange-boundary penetration through the enclosure, was visible.
visual_decision.dispersion_screen: No obvious catastrophic dispersion, explosive particle cloud, or detached spray dominating the scene was visible; this is only a visual screen.
visual_decision.truncation_screen: No visible early termination: contacts cover the published 801-frame sequence and the final inspected key is frame 800.
visual_decision.failure_screen: No obvious severe visual failure in initial, mid, or late inspected views at renderer camera scale.
limitations: Static PNGs cannot establish pressure, convergence, numerical precision, UID lifecycle, strict containment, or sub-DP behavior.
No quantitative penetration or dispersion threshold is certified.
Root QI1440 is separate metadata evidence, not this delegated visual judgment.
There are no floating particles; floating-body conclusions do not apply.

physical_and_time_metadata.time_policy: Actual producer times retained; nominal 16.0 s is not substituted and no resampling is claimed.

render_receipt_observed.role: current original render receipt (only if atomically published)

render_report_observed.role: current original full-animation report (only if present)

root_qi_evidence.proof_role: root-owned independent full801 QI metadata; not delegated personal visual review
